Thanks Lauren — quick technical notes from the infra/serving side:

1) Artifacts we can provide:
   - SOC 2 Type II summary + scope statement (redacted)
   - Network diagram showing Redwood Private/VPC options and data flow for SaaS integrations
   - Performance profile for verified model variants (latency/throughput ranges by GPU family)

2) Billing & listing options:
   - AWS: SaaS Metering (SaaS-Onboarding v2) is the cleanest for a jointly-billed end-customer experience, but Nimbus will need to implement the metering API and agree contractually with an NSP. Timeline: 6-8 weeks if dependencies are ready.
   - Azure: Marketplace supports SaaS and private offers; Azure requires publisher onboarding + commercial marketplace validation. Timeline: 8-10 weeks typically.
   - GCP: Listing + resale via partner reseller program; GCP often requires a direct integration with their entitlement APIs. Timeline: 8-12 weeks.

3) Technical owners:
   - Billing integration: Jordan (I can support lead tech review)
   - Security evidence & network diagrams: Marcus (ownership)
   - Listing artifacts + marketing description: Vanessa (partner GTM)

Questions for Marcus: is the SOC 2 excerpt in the checklist sufficient for initial listing, or do clouds often request additional controls evidence?

I'll be at the Friday sync.

— Karthik
Staff Product Manager, Redwood Inference
